items.text: umm actually I dont have cash right now so can I pay online
I think the delivery guy came yesterday no I mean today but I was not home
like I wanted to pay cod but the app is not showing the option now
uhm can you tell me if there is any extra charge for cod payment
I cant find my wallet so can you hold the delivery for one more day
sorry I meant Thursday not Tuesday can you change the delivery date please

items.context: Can you confirm if you have cash on hand for the delivery?
items.text: I dont have cash because it is holiday today so postponed please

items.context: Did the delivery person try to collect cash from you?
items.text: actually I tried to pay cash but the courier refused to accept it

items.context: Do you want to know the total amount due for cash on delivery?
items.text: can you tell me how much I need to pay at the door

items.context: Was the card machine working at your delivery location?
items.text: umm no I want to pay with card swipe but the machine was not working
I was expecting the delivery on Tuesday but it came on Wednesday so I was not ready with the cash then
the courier called me twice but I was in a meeting so I could not collect the parcel or pay him on time

items.context: Can you explain why you were unable to complete the cash on delivery payment?
items.text: I am sorry I missed the payment because the delivery boy came late in the evening and I only had online payments left

items.context: Are you facing any restrictions with paying cash on delivery today?
items.text: I wanted to pay by cash but the delivery person said they dont accept cash due to safety concerns now can you guide me please

request.system:
You write realistic things that customers say to a voice agent on a phone call in India.
Write what the customer says out loud, as speech recognition would transcribe it:
natural spoken word order, fillers kept, no punctuation needed.
Each utterance is one complete customer turn: the customer has finished speaking
and is waiting for the agent to reply.
request.user:

Language: Indian English, Latin script.
Style for this batch: with fillers and hesitations (umm, uh, like, actually, I mean); at least a third include a self-correction ('Tuesday, no, Wednesday')

Write exactly 18 different customer turns in these six groups:
- "short": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words (for example 'yes please', 'tomorrow', 'card ending 4321'),
- "short_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 1-4 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "medium": exactly 6 turns of 5-12 words,
- "medium_with_context": exactly 4 turns of 5-12 words, each with the agent's question before it,
- "long": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words,
- "long_with_context": exactly 2 turns of 13-30 words, each with the agent's question before it.
In the *_with_context groups, "context" is the question the agent asked just before that turn.
Vary people, amounts, dates, names and places. Do not number them. Do not start two turns the same way.
Return JSON: {"short": [{"text": "..."}, ...], "short_with_context": [{"text": "...", "context": "..."}, ...],
"medium": [...], "medium_with_context": [...], "long": [...], "long_with_context": [...]}
Every turn and question must be in Latin script.
